title: Who we are
slide_intent: Connect a product description to what people do together. A clear definition gives writers a common starting point before they choose more specific language.
strategic_value: Slack can link its platform to coordination at work and reinforce a consistent way to name its service.
demonstration: A large aubergine statement on the left describes the work platform. The right column sets out the mission, vision and grammatical use of the Slack name.
practical_value: Choose the mission, vision or product description according to what a communication needs to explain, and check how it uses the brand name.

content_islands.name: Positioning statement

content_islands.name: Mission, vision and naming
